tei:div.tei:p: 339) ༄༅/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg bzhugs so// 340)༄༅/

rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong du sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ thog mar gang du bya ba'i sa chog mdor bsdus ni/ dkar gtor/ gser skyems/ dri bzang dang ba byung gi chu/ thig tshon sogs 'du byas la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byaṃ shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor 341)don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol/ sngon gtor dang*/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud ma'i gser skyems ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha/ khyad par rdo sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod// ma mgon lcam dral tshe ring mched lnga dang*// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod// sngags 'chang bdag 342)gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi'i gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas sar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas nas stong pa nyid du rgyas btab/

oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis ba byung dang dri bzang gis chag chag g.yas bskor du gdab/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika rang nyid rdor sems su gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi thig skud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes lnga dang dbyer med par gyur/ dzaḥdzaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā am̐ hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzla bzhin du thig gdab/ tshon rnams rdor sems yab yum kyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rin po che'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ gong ltar 'bru gsum dang rigs lnga'i sa bon brgya rtsa brjod nas byin gyis brlab la bkye'o// dngos gzhi la/ tshig bdun gsol 343) 'debs/ brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu sgrub pa/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs bsags nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ gsol gdab bsdu rim/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pas lhar ldang*/ de nas rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ rdor dril 'khyud rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ta khā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 ham̐ zhes dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhe sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams gzhi dang rgyan dang dbyibs dang bkod pa tshad med pas mngon par 'phags pa'i phyogs kun tu rin po che dang pad+ma la sogs pa'i snod phun sum tshogs par hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs sil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga rin po che sna bdun bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug 344) mchog gi ma da na dang ru dhi ra sna tshogs pa'i bza' bca' ldag myang la sogs pa zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams su lhun gyis grub pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo kegan+dhe/ naibid+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba pañca a mri ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa kham̐ gi bar gyis mchod pa byin gyis rlab/ sbyin sreg gzhung gi oṃ swā hā/ lan gsum re btang nas/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas rdzas rnams la reg bzhin du/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsreg rdzas so so'i rnam par gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum/ 335) 'og gi rdzas sngags/ oṃ bo dhi dh+rik+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum re/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba sam+pa de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ ma hā kro dhi sa bsang chung gtor dgos/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la raṃ gyis me sbar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ oṃ ag+ne swā hā sa mar khu 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ swā hā/ ku sha bkram/ ma hā kro dha ིsa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i 346)thab khung zlum zhing dkar ba mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus su pad zla la gnas pa'i ram̐ las zhi ba'i me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng*/

g.yon gnyis ril ba dang skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ drang srong gi cha byad can 'khor tshogs du mas bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gis 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/ lag g.yas kyi mthe baung g.yab cing*/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ag+na ye ā kar+sha ya dzaḥ yi rjes su las sngags/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ ag+ni de wa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā sa mchod yon dang*/ pād+yaṃ gis zhabs sil 'bul/ 347)oṃ ag+na ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dgang blugs bzung bzhin/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ mar khu sngags grangs 'bul bzhin du/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ lan bdun mthar/ oṃ ag+ne ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bar lan gsum gyis dgang blugs nyer gcig song nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad pa// bdag gzhan don sgrub pa la bzhugs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la bstod/ rdzas phud blang nas/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ lan bdun 348) rjes/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'dod gsol tshar gcig de 'dra bas/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la= til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/

sdig pa thams cad shan+tiṃ= zho zan/ oṃ sarba sam+pa de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la= 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la= sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la= gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la= durba/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la= ku sha oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar 349)du gcod pa thams shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bcas bdun re rdzogs nas/ ag+na ye dī bya sogs tshar bdun gyi rdzas spungs 'bul kyang chog yang*/ oṃ ag+na ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba h+na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tshar gcig gis yungs dkar thab tu 'thor/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du stob pa dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs te bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gyi dus mar khu gzar bus g.yas bskor gyis shar lhor blugs nas/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes dang*/ ma hā kro dhi sa bsang*/ shu n+ya ta sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su e las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sogs mdun bskyed ltar blang nas/ spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur/ phyag 'tshal nas bzung bstod pa'i bar du btang*/ dgang blugs bzung bzhin du/ dkyil 350)'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig yang yig drug lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig yang yig drug lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig gis dgang blugs nyer gcig song nas/ rdzas 'bul ba la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan gcig oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ tshar bcu/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs sogs 'dod gsol tshar gcig de 'dra bas/

mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ durba/ ku sha bcas bcu re rdzogs pas sbyin sreg tshar brgya song ba yin/ yang yam shing mar khu nas ku sha yan tshar bcu re 'khor bas/ de 'dra ba tsho bcu grub pas sbyin sreg stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg la gong du bshad pa'i sbyin sreg rdzas so so ba brgya tsam song rjes/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ kho nas rdzas 351) sprungs 'phul ste bsnyen pa'i bcu cha ma 'gro bar grangs bzung dgos pas thun re re bzhin sbyin sreg gi mgo mtha' tshang ma btang dgos/ de nas mtha' bsdu ba ni/ yig brgya tshar gcig yungs kar thab tu 'bul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de nas byon skyems/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig gis 'bul ba de 'dra lan gsum gyis byon skyems nyer gcig song nas/ bdag bskyed ltar/ gtsang dme'i dri rtog kun bral ba'i// rā sa yā na'i sman chen po// nyon mongs chags pa'i rak+tar bcas// mnyam pa chen por bzhes su gsol/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta a la la ho/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i snying po can// bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs ldan pa'i// dam rdzas mchog gi gtor ma 'di// gnyis su 352)med par bzhes su gsol/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ lha gzhung bsreg gtor 'bul/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha sogs kyis mchod/ mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni// dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs// thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston// rdo rje sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ dang*/ ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la ram̐ gyis mar khu shar lho nas bskor te dkyil du blugs/ slar yang me lha cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ dgang blugs/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+ne ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī 353)ha bya ka bya ba h+na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bar lan gsum gyis dgang blugs nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ bho dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ lan bdun/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa= lan gcig sbyar ba nas ku sha yan chad lan bdun re rdzogs nas/ oṃ ag+ne ye a ka ro sogs btags pas me lha'i gtor ma phul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod/ bar dang*/ yig brgya lan gcig ma rnyed yongs su sogs dang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za 354)khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar spyon la// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ a ka ro sa dung zhal gyi 'o mas me gzhil/ las gzhung ltar/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ deng 'dir brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs dang*// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba rnams// bsdoms te bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma gus ldan// dpal ldan rdo rje'i theg la nges gnas shog /dbang gis smin cing dam tshig sdom par ldan// rim gnyis lam la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin te// dka' ba med par rig 'dzin go 'phang bgrod// dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub gyur cig

/cir snang sgyu 355)'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor rdzogs// grags pa thams cad brjod bral sngags kyi sgra// sems kyi 'gyu ba rang rig 'dus ma byas// bde chen 'du 'bral med par mngon gyur shog /gnas skabs kun tu dngos grub mchog sgrub pa'i// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen ma tshang med las skye ba 'dir// don gnyis bsam pa lhun gyi 'grub par shog 'chi srid chos sku'i go 'phang mngon gyur te// bar do sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur langs nas// mkha' spyod gnas su kun bzang spyod pa mchog /dka' ba med par myur du rdzogs par shog /spyod pa rgya mtshos ye shes sa kun rdzogs// gzhan don ris med gdul bya'i khams bzhin 'jug /sgrib bral mkha' mnyam zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// tshe 'di nyid la myur du 'grub par shog bsngo smon dang*// bkra shis ni/ 356)ye dharma sogs/ oṃ/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub char 'bebs zhi dang khro// yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub// dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog ༈

ro sreg byed na/ rdor sems gzhung chog gnas 'dren gyi lam bstan yan chad grub nas/ ro la gnas lung ltar zhi sbyong phyed ma/ drag sbyong bcas dang*/ til sbyang mi dgos/ yig brgya dang*/ da ha= sogs kyis bye yungs brab/ khrus gsol sku phyi bcas/ bdag bskyed ltar/ shu n+ya ta= 'khor 'das chos kun= sogs nas/ mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bar gyis ro rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba la mchod bstod bcas grub nas sbyin sreg la 'jug/ me sbar / ag+ne dz+wa la 'i sngags kyi 357) gong du gnas lugs kyi me sbar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung= sogs sbyor ba las/ 'don lugs gzhan gong du bshad pa ltar bya/ sbyin sreg tshar nas tshogs drang ba man mtha' dbyung ngo*/ sgrub mchod dang sbyin sreg sbrel lugs gzhung dang sgrub khog las gsal ba ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang bla ma o rgyan dpal 'byor gyi nyams bzhes gsal byed du/ thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ// 358)
